svg.title: Xom Arcade Analytics Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Modern Data Stack architecture diagram illustrating data flow from SQL Server through Fivetran into Supabase Postgres, transformed via dbt Core medallion layers, and visualized with dbt Charts and dbt Docs.

g.text: Automated Ingestion (Fivetran) · Cloud Warehousing (Supabase Postgres) · Medallion Transformations (dbt Core) · Analytics & Governance (dbt Charts & Docs)
dbt CORE MEDALLION DATA ARCHITECTURE (STORAGE & MODEL LAYERS)
Layered transformation ensures data contract enforcement, business logic isolation, and high-performance BI queries
• Declares raw external tables from Fivetran
• Zero transformation; preserves raw audit trail
• Trims strings & standardizes empty text to NULL
• Casts size to MB, prices to numeric, dates to DATE
• Parses language lists & derives monetization flags
Data Catalog, Interactive Lineage DAG & Column Dictionaries
🔒 Security & Secrets: Production credentials managed strictly via local environment variables (.env), excluded from version control.
✅ Data Quality: 11+ Automated tests, unique grain & financial reconciliation assertions.
